headline: What Happened to the War Risk Insurance Portfolio in Ukraine in the First Half of 2026?
summary: ARX settled 141 war-risk insurance claims over the first six months of 2026, paying out UAH 25.97 million in total.
why: War-risk insurance covers losses from conflict damage to property and assets, and its claims data indicate the scale of wartime economic losses.
